status: Exploratory follow-up after the entire cohort and earlier results were inspected; settings saved before these new fits, no preregistration or fresh-cohort claim
design_selection: First fixed rows from the saved development-only ridge designs, pooled equally across both tasks; identical input arrays and trial/artifact identities for all three targets
selection: Fixed final epoch 50 is primary for every target and seed. Validation loss is diagnostic only; no target-specific early stopping or ERP selection.
pairing: Within architecture/seed: identical initialized state, minibatch permutations, dropout seed, optimizer configuration, input scaling and epoch budget; only supervisory values change
deployment: Same 2-s, 512-sample, per-channel input-SD interface as training; restore input scale and baseline. Equal mean of three seed outputs. Development/evaluation people only; no nominal cross-fitting of ERP-trained models.
sanity: All held-out EEGdenoiseNet reference windows with no added artifact; original ERP parent inputs; per-window mean-centering; fixed development channel SD; overlap-averaged 2-s windows in actual 4-s contexts for eight fixed backgrounds per person
identity_tolerance: 10-percent relative waveform RMS is a declared descriptive engineering screen, not physiological equivalence or a required property of an MMSE denoiser
scope: Target-definition effects of two automated constructions on digital outputs; not the original released labels, true cortical loss, or the unique cause of historical CNN deployment failure
